array_boyermoore_majorityelement.png.title: Majority Element
array_boyermoore_majorityelement.png.problem: Given an integer array of size n, return the element that appears more than n/2 times. You may assume such an element always exists.

array_cyclicsort_firstmissingpositive.pn.title: First Missing Positive
array_cyclicsort_firstmissingpositive.pn.problem: Given an unsorted integer array, return the smallest positive integer that does not appear in it, using O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

array_reverse_rotatearray.png.title: Rotate Array
array_reverse_rotatearray.png.problem: Given an integer array and a non-negative integer k, rotate the array to the right by k steps, ideally in place.

array_runlength_adjacentincreasingsubarr.title: Adjacent Increasing Subarrays Detection II
array_runlength_adjacentincreasingsubarr.problem: Given an integer array, return the maximum k such that there exist two adjacent subarrays of length k that are both strictly increasing.

array_sentinel_missingranges.png.title: Missing Ranges
array_sentinel_missingranges.png.problem: Given a sorted unique integer array and an inclusive range [lower, upper], return the shortest sorted list of ranges that exactly covers every number in the range that is missing from the array.

backtracking_dfs_robotroomcleaner.png.title: Robot Room Cleaner
backtracking_dfs_robotroomcleaner.png.problem: You control a robot in an unknown grid room through an API (move, turnLeft, turnRight, clean) without knowing the layout or its starting position. Clean every reachable cell.

backtracking_dfs_wordsearch.png.title: Word Search
backtracking_dfs_wordsearch.png.problem: Given an m x n grid of characters and a word, return true if the word can be formed from sequentially adjacent (horizontal or vertical) cells, using each cell at most once.

binarysearch_invariant_truefalsetransiti.title: Find a True-to-False Transition
binarysearch_invariant_truefalsetransiti.problem: Given a boolean array where the first element is true and the last is false (not necessarily sorted), find any index i such that arr[i] is true and arr[i+1] is false, in O(log n) time.

concurrency_mutex_trafficlightcontrolled.title: Traffic Light Controlled Intersection
concurrency_mutex_trafficlightcontrolled.problem: Cars arrive concurrently on two roads that meet at an intersection with one traffic light. Implement carArrived so that cars cross only when their road is green, switching the light when needed, and avoid deadlock.

design_bisect_snapshotarray.png.title: Snapshot Array
design_bisect_snapshotarray.png.problem: Design an array-like structure that supports set(index, val), snap() which returns a snapshot id, and get(index, snap_id) which returns the value at that index when that snapshot was taken.

design_bisect_timebasedkeyvaluestore.png.title: Time Based Key-Value Store
design_bisect_timebasedkeyvaluestore.png.problem: Design a key-value store where set(key, value, timestamp) stores values over time and get(key, timestamp) returns the value with the largest timestamp less than or equal to the given one, or empty string if none.

design_bucket_loosemediandatastructure.p.title: Loose Median Data Structure
design_bucket_loosemediandatastructure.p.problem: Design a structure over positive integers supporting insert(x) and looseMedian(), where looseMedian returns any value in the power-of-two range [2^k, 2^(k+1)) that contains the true median. Both operations should be O(1) for fixed-width integers.

design_bucketlist_alloonedatastructure.p.title: All O(1) Data Structure
design_bucketlist_alloonedatastructure.p.problem: Design a structure that counts string keys and supports inc(key), dec(key), getMaxKey() and getMinKey(), all in O(1) time.

design_hashmap_loggerratelimiter.png.title: Logger Rate Limiter
design_hashmap_loggerratelimiter.png.problem: Design a logger that receives messages with timestamps and returns whether each message should be printed, where the same message may be printed at most once every 10 seconds.

design_hashmaparray_insertdeletegetrando.title: Insert Delete GetRandom O(1)
design_hashmaparray_insertdeletegetrando.problem: Design a set that supports insert, remove and getRandom (each current element equally likely), all in average O(1) time.

design_iterator_rleiterator.png.title: RLE Iterator
design_iterator_rleiterator.png.problem: Given a run-length encoded array of (count, value) pairs, implement next(n) that exhausts the next n elements and returns the last one exhausted, or -1 if there are not enough elements left.

design_lazyheap_stockpricefluctuation.pn.title: Stock Price Fluctuation
design_lazyheap_stockpricefluctuation.pn.problem: Process a stream of (timestamp, price) records that may arrive out of order and may correct earlier timestamps. Support update, current (price at the latest timestamp), maximum and minimum price.

design_lazypropagation_stackwithincremen.title: Design a Stack With Increment Operation
design_lazypropagation_stackwithincremen.problem: Design a stack with a maximum size supporting push, pop, and increment(k, val), which adds val to the bottom k elements (or all of them if there are fewer than k).

design_ordereddict_lfucache.png.title: LFU Cache
design_ordereddict_lfucache.png.problem: Design a fixed-capacity cache with O(1) get and put that evicts the least frequently used key when full, breaking ties by least recently used.

design_quickselect_filesystemsizeanalysi.title: File System Size Analysis
design_quickselect_filesystemsizeanalysi.problem: Given a list of file paths with sizes, build a structure that reports the total size of any directory and returns the k largest files or folders.

design_slidingwindow_designaratelimiter..title: Design a Rate Limiter
design_slidingwindow_designaratelimiter..problem: Design a thread-safe rate limiter that allows at most N requests in any rolling 1-second window and returns whether each incoming request is allowed.

design_trie_designinmemoryfilesystem.png.title: Design In-Memory File System
design_trie_designinmemoryfilesystem.png.problem: Design an in-memory file system supporting ls(path), mkdir(path), addContentToFile(path, content) and readContentFromFile(path), with ls returning sorted names.

design_twostacks_designatexteditor.png.title: Design a Text Editor
design_twostacks_designatexteditor.png.problem: Design a text editor with a cursor supporting addText, deleteText(k), cursorLeft(k) and cursorRight(k), where the cursor moves return the last up to 10 characters to the left of the cursor.

dp_interval_longestpalindromicsubstring..title: Longest Palindromic Substring
dp_interval_longestpalindromicsubstring..problem: Given a string, return its longest substring that is a palindrome.

dp_kadane_maximumsubarray.png.title: Maximum Subarray
dp_kadane_maximumsubarray.png.problem: Given an integer array, return the largest sum of any non-empty contiguous subarray.

dp_knapsack_01knapsackbinaryprofit.png.title: 0/1 Knapsack (Binary Profit)
dp_knapsack_01knapsackbinaryprofit.png.problem: Given items with weights and profits that are only 1 or 2, and a knapsack capacity, choose a subset of items (each at most once) to maximize total profit without exceeding capacity.

dp_lis_longestincreasingsubsequence.png.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
dp_lis_longestincreasingsubsequence.png.problem: Given an integer array, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

dp_memo_lastkeptballblueprobability.png.title: Last Kept Ball Is Blue
dp_memo_lastkeptballblueprobability.png.problem: A bag has 2 red and 2 blue balls. You draw at random: a red is always kept; a blue is put back unless it is the second blue in a row, in which case it is kept. Return the probability that the last ball kept is blue.

dp_memo_longestincreasingpathinamatrix.p.title: Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix
dp_memo_longestincreasingpathinamatrix.p.problem: Given an m x n integer matrix, return the length of the longest path of strictly increasing values moving up, down, left or right.

dp_minimax_stonegame3.png.title: Stone Game III
dp_minimax_stonegame3.png.problem: Alice and Bob take turns removing 1, 2 or 3 stones from the front of a row of valued stones, scoring their values. Both play optimally; return "Alice", "Bob" or "Tie".

dp_prefixsum_numberofzigzagarrays1.png.title: Number of ZigZag Arrays I
dp_prefixsum_numberofzigzagarrays1.png.problem: Given n, l and r, count arrays of length n with values in [l, r] where adjacent elements differ and the comparisons strictly alternate between increasing and decreasing. Return the count modulo 1e9+7.

dp_segmenttree_longestincreasingsubseque.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence II
dp_segmenttree_longestincreasingsubseque.problem: Given an integer array and k, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence where adjacent elements differ by at most k.

dp_tabulation_dungeongame.png.title: Dungeon Game
dp_tabulation_dungeongame.png.problem: A knight starts at the top-left of a grid of health gains and losses and moves only right or down to the princess at the bottom-right. Return the minimum initial health needed so health never drops to 0 or below.

dp_tabulation_jumpgame2.png.title: Jump Game II
dp_tabulation_jumpgame2.png.problem: Given an array where nums[i] is the maximum jump length from index i, return the minimum number of jumps to reach the last index (which is guaranteed reachable).

dp_tabulation_minimumtimetofinishtherace.title: Minimum Time to Finish the Race
dp_tabulation_minimumtimetofinishtherace.problem: Each tire i takes f_i * r_i^(x-1) seconds for its x-th consecutive lap, and changing tires costs changeTime. Given unlimited tires of each type, return the minimum time to finish numLaps laps.

dp_tabulation_regularexpressionmatching..title: Regular Expression Matching
dp_tabulation_regularexpressionmatching..problem: Given a string s and a pattern p containing '.' (any single character) and '*' (zero or more of the preceding element), return whether p matches the entire string s.

dp_tabulation_wordbreak.png.title: Word Break
dp_tabulation_wordbreak.png.problem: Given a string and a dictionary of words, return true if the string can be segmented into a sequence of one or more dictionary words (words may be reused).

graph_bellmanford_cheapestflightswithink.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
graph_bellmanford_cheapestflightswithink.problem: Given n cities and priced directed flights, return the cheapest price from src to dst using at most k stops, or -1 if impossible.

graph_bfs_busroutes.png.title: Bus Routes
graph_bfs_busroutes.png.problem: Given bus routes where each bus loops through a list of stops, return the minimum number of buses you must take to travel from source stop to target stop, or -1 if impossible.

graph_bfs_escapethespreadingfire.png.title: Escape the Spreading Fire
graph_bfs_escapethespreadingfire.png.problem: In a grid of grass, fire and walls, fire spreads to adjacent grass each minute while you move from the top-left to the safehouse at the bottom-right. Return the maximum minutes you can wait before leaving and still arrive safely (-1 if impossible, 1e9 if always possible).
